content_verification.access_route: data/articles/zhang2025b.pdf (publisher PDF, 12 pp., gitignored), text layer re-read 2026-10-28 for the methods and Table 2 cells quoted here; dossier zhang2025b_extraction.md checked Table 2 against 150 dpi page images.
content_verification.quoted_method: 2.2 Model reaction, verbatim: 'In a 15-mL pressure glass vial, 0.2 mmol of cysteine, 0.2 mmol of xylose, lysine at 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, or 16 times the amount of cysteine, and 5 mL of phosphate buffer (0.2 mol/L, pH 6.5) were added. The vials were heated at 120 C for a total of 50 mins on a Parallel Synthesis Poly-Block 4 system (HEL Co. Ltd., United Kingdom).' THIS BUNDLE SCORES THE BLANK (lysine 0) ONLY: lysine resolves to the acrylamide lane and the engine refuses a lysine + cysteine pot as a lane conflict (declare_envelope, 2026-10-28).
content_verification.quoted_quantification: 2.3.1, verbatim: 'The reaction solutions were added with 1 uL of internal (1,2-dichlorobenzene, 73 ug/mL in methanol) and 2.0 g of sodium chloride. After pre-equilibrating at 50 C for 15 min, they were headspace adsorbed for 20 min using a 50/35 um carboxen/polydimethylsiloxane/divinylbenzene (CAR/PDMS/DVB) fiber'. No response factor, calibration curve or labelled standard is described for any volatile.
content_verification.quoted_table: Table 2 (pp. 4-5), 'Concentrations (ng/mL)', blank column (cysteine-xylose, no lysine), as printed: '8 1328 865 2-methyl-3-furanthiol 22.63 +/- 4.09b'; '11 1422 909 2-furfurylthiol 0.29 +/- 0.03a'; '15 1630 1020 2-acetylthiazole 114.13 +/- 15.98d'; '25 2145 1525 bis(2-methyl-3-furyl) disulfide 18.25 +/- 2.77b'. Footnote 2: 'The concentrations were the sums detected from both the DB-WAX and HP-5 MS capillary columns. Results were the means of three replicates.'
content_verification.quantification_verdict: SEMI-QUANTITATIVE, DECLARED AS SUCH. One internal standard (1,2-dichlorobenzene) for every analyte, HS-SPME, no response factors; the values are internal-standard equivalents. The Table 2 footnote says the concentrations are 'the sums detected from both the DB-WAX and HP-5 MS capillary columns', whose meaning is not explained (two injections summed would double-count). The dossier's own reading: treat as order-of-magnitude, x3 at least. The headspace class carries the envelope's K_aw and HS-SPME bands (src/quantification.py).
content_verification.what_is_deliberately_not_ingested: (a) The six lysine arms (engine lane conflict; see quoted_method). (b) 3-mercapto-2-pentanone, 3-mercapto-2-butanone, thiophenes, thiazoles and pyrazines: no engine species. (c) Fig. 2 TTCA / Cys-Amadori / free cysteine time courses: figure-digitised, and TTCA is not a reportable engine target. (d) Furfural: not reported in any arm of Table 2.

fit_holdout_status: INDEPENDENT. No core fit generator (generate_kinetic_core_b*_fit.py, the B47 52-row objective the engine reads through B51) carries Zhang 2025b, the Xie group's cysteine-xylose pots, or this DOI; checked by grep on 2026-10-28. The system is cysteine + pentose like the Hofmann 1998 fit pots, but at 120 C, pH 6.5, 0.2 M phosphate and 50 min, a state no fit row integrates.

precursor_concentration_provenance.derivation: 0.2 mmol cysteine and 0.2 mmol xylose in 5 mL buffer = 40 mmol/L each. Moles and volume printed (quoted_method).
precursor_concentration_provenance.residual_caveats: (a) Start pH only; no post-heating pH. (b) No come-up time for the heating block. (c) The paper's Fig. 2 puts ~45 % of the cysteine in TTCA by 30-50 min, which the engine does not form from Cys + pentose (recorded in tasks/data_restructure_plan.md, network gap (a)); that is part of what this row tests, not a reason to exclude it.

conditions.water_activity_note: Not stated by the source; 0.98 is this repository's convention for a dilute aqueous pot (the Yiltirak and Hofmann hold-outs carry the same value).

buffer.provenance_note: Zhang, Tan, He, Hu, Li & Xie 2025, Food Chem. 469:142529, sec. 2.2 (Model reaction), read from data/articles/zhang2025b.pdf on 2026-10-28, verbatim: 'In a 15-mL pressure glass vial, 0.2 mmol of cysteine, 0.2 mmol of xylose, lysine at 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, or 16 times the amount of cysteine, and 5 mL of phosphate buffer (0.2 mol/L, pH 6.5) were added.' The counter-ion (sodium or potassium) is not stated; the pH is the bench value before heating and no post-heating pH is reported. Dossier: zhang2025b_extraction.md.

Dossier: zhang2025b_extraction.md.

metadata.notes: Cysteine + xylose 40/40 mM, 0.2 M phosphate pH 6.5, 120 C, 50 min, sealed 15 mL vial. The first pH-6.5 cysteine-pentose level row in the hold-out (the Hofmann bundles are pH 3/5/7 at 145 C; Yiltirak pH 5.5). Semi-quantitative: read the fold error against a x3 measurement band.
